reason: At packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts:151, the patch drops the negation when converting `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug }` to `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {}` while line 153 keeps `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { requestedSlug: slug } : {}`. As a result, billing-enabled orgs receive `slug` immediately before payment, and billing-disabled orgs have neither `slug` nor `metadata.requestedSlug`, which triggers `NoOrganizationSlugError` at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/createTeams.handler.ts:67-69.
